title: Csv Export
instruction: Add --csv <file> to logtool, accepted before or after the input filename. Write the aggregate rows to that file while retaining the normal stdout summary. The header must be hour,source,count,errors, in the same ordering as the summary. Produce RFC 4180 CSV: CRLF record separators, trailing CRLF, and correct escaping of commas, quotes, CR and LF inside fields. Include the header for empty input. Missing option values are usage errors (exit 2, no input read); export failures exit 1 with an error message. Update help and add tests for this feature.
